dashboard.name: Analytics basics
dashboard.description: Key business metrics for the SaaS app: conversions, churn, and user engagement

insights.name: User Signup Funnel
insights.description: Tracks the complete user signup flow from registration through onboarding steps
insights.hogql_alternative: SELECT funnel_step, count() as users FROM (SELECT person_id, arrayJoin([1, 2, 3, 4]) as funnel_step FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event IN ['user_registered', 'user_signed_up_completed', 'onboarding_user_account_completed', 'onboarding_organization_created'] GROUP BY person_id) GROUP BY funnel_step

insights.name: Subscription Conversion Rate
insights.description: Daily trend comparing users who start checkout vs those who complete it
insights.hogql_query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) as date, event, count() as count FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event IN ['subscription_checkout_started', 'checkout_session_completed'] GROUP BY date, event ORDER BY date, event

insights.name: Subscription Churn
insights.description: Weekly comparison of subscription cancellations vs resumptions
insights.hogql_query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(timestamp) as week, event, count() as count FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND event IN ['subscription_cancelled', 'subscription_resumed'] GROUP BY week, event ORDER BY week, event

insights.name: Daily Active Users (Logins)
insights.description: Daily count of unique users logging into the application
insights.hogql_query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) as date, uniq(person_id) as daily_active_users FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'user_logged_in' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

insights.name: Contact Sales Submissions
insights.description: Daily trend of contact sales form submissions over the past 90 days
insights.hogql_query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) as date, count() as submissions FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND event = 'contact_sales_submitted' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

api_instructions.note: These are the API calls you would need to make with an API key that has the following scopes: dashboard:write, insight:write

payload_structure.name: Insight name
payload_structure.query: Query object from insights array above

add_insight_to_dashboard.note: Add insight IDs to the dashboard's tiles array

manual_setup_instructions.step_3: Enter name: 'Analytics basics' and description: 'Key business metrics for the SaaS app: conversions, churn, and user engagement'
manual_setup_instructions.step_4: For each insight, click 'New insight' and select the appropriate type (Funnel or Trend)
manual_setup_instructions.step_5: Copy the query JSON from the insights array above into the PostHog query editor (switch to JSON mode)
manual_setup_instructions.step_6: Save each insight and add it to the dashboard
